During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a '''battle''' betweeen between the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] occurred above the planet of [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]]. The battle was the result of the ambush of an Imperial reconnaissance squadron on a classified mission by the Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadron nicknamed the [[Solar Thrantas|"Solar Thrantas"]], led by the notorious ace [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Nezhel Othren|Nezhel "Sunspot" Othren]]. The skirmish turned into a battle when both sides reinforced their starfighters with several capital ships. Eventually the Empire came out on top when members of the [[Empire's Fury]] squadron arrived and eliminated Othren and his squadron.<ref name="Saleucami Fleet Action" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle above Saleucami appears as Saleucami Fleet Action, one of the Space Missions available in the MMO ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Imperial players are called in to destroy a minimum of five Red Talon fighters and the single [[BT-7 Thunderclap]]. It is the Imperial counterpart of the [[Battle of Javaal|Javaal Fleet Action]]. Together with [[Attack on the Hutt Cartel listening post|Cartel Listening Post]] it is part of the mission [[Operation Echo Quake]].<ref name="Saleucami Fleet Action" />
